text:
marie: Heads-up: we're introducing `X-RI-Route-Broker` header (JSON) to centralize route matching + quota hints. Need SDK compatibility plan for py/ts/go.

eli: Is this replacing `Route-Hint`?

marie: Not immediately. Broker will be honored when present; fallback to `Route-Hint` otherwise. Migration via opt-in canary.

pav: SDK requirements: accept either string or object for the new param. If given string, wrap to {"route": <string>}. Send legacy header alongside during canary.

eli: Propose opt-in flag: `enable_route_broker` default false. Emit telemetry `sdk.route_broker.sent` with `sdk_name` and `opted_in`. Console can use that for adoption metrics.

ops-bot: Console: add tile "Broker adoption" and tag traces with `client_id` from broker payload to correlate. Please ensure `client_id` is non-PII.

marie: We'll provide `GET /v1/route-broker/debug` (internal) that echoes parsed header for debugging. Docs will include small snippets for py/ts/go.

pav: Semver: minor bumps only. Add unit tests for serialization + an e2e against debug endpoint. Also emit `sdk.route_broker.warn_parse` if input is non-JSON and had to be coerced.

deploy-bot: schedule: route-broker v0.1-canary -> infra-canary at 03:30 UTC. Rollback if 5xx rate > 2x or quota mismatch > 2% in first 15m.

marie: Action items: pav -> open SDK PRs, eli -> migration docs + examples, ops-bot -> telemetry mapping & dashboard tile, qa -> runbook. Keep rollout 5% traffic for 2w. :thumbsup:

pav: ack

eli: ack

(End)
